title: Kharuun Assemblies provisional visual asset cards

authority.status: PROVISIONAL PRODUCTION CONTRACTS, authored in the isolated production worktree
authority.source: Owner ruling 2026-09-07 answering EBS-KHA-BLD-001 OWNER-QUESTION A: confirm 8,000/3,500 as the Memory Hearth's provisional ceilings, author a dedicated Kharuun asset card, and apply the same card-authoring process to every remaining Kharuun package.
what_this_is_not: NOT an amendment to Docs/Requirements.md. Section 18.2 still carries Meridian cards only; nothing in this file has been incorporated there.
NOT existing authoritative per-asset requirements. The owner stated plainly that these match the preparation pipeline's selected limits and are not existing authoritative contracts.
NOT owner acceptance of any asset built against them.
NOT a licence to mark any asset technically compliant. Final technical acceptance stays pending until these cards are incorporated into the authoritative requirements and their checks pass.
binding_requirements_above_these_cards: REL-ART-029 — Kharuun Roster Grown Mineral Architecture: faceted basalt silhouette, zero organic smoothing, packed 2048x2048 PBR stacks with micro-noise normal maps, amber emissive clamped to <= 15.0% of mesh surface area.
REL-ART-030 — landscape passability truth, where an asset touches walkable ground.
REL-BLD-016 / SPEC-UNIT-005..008 — the function profiles and canon rows named per card.

faction_rules.no_meridian_anatomy: Owner ruling 2026-09-07. Meridian machinery, tread language, orthogonal load frames, exposed conduits, heavy plate seams and the cyan status treatment do not transfer to any Kharuun asset. Kharuun status colour is amber.
faction_rules.no_shared_rig: Owner ruling 2026-09-07. Rigs are specified per asset from that asset's anatomy and motion. One faction rig is NOT to be copied across the roster; the bone plans below deliberately differ in structure, not only in count.
faction_rules.emissive_is_a_ceiling: Owner ruling 2026-09-07. The 15% amber surface-area figure is a ceiling, not a target. Amber is localised to the canon-named features and nowhere else.
faction_rules.budget_scope: Owner ruling 2026-09-07. Triangle budgets cover the COMPLETE assembly including every articulated part and separately controlled sub-object.
faction_rules.default_ceilings: 8,000 LOD0 / 3,500 LOD1 where no tighter contract exists.
faction_rules.texture_stack: 2048x2048 packed PBR (albedo, normal with micro-noise detail, roughness/metallic packed, emissive mask), per REL-ART-029.

cards.subject: Memory Hearth
cards.function: REL-BLD-016.KA.HEARTH — headquarters drop-off, 1,300 HP, 800 cm sight, +12 logistics, 5x5 footprint, produces Tenders

mesh_prop.scope: the complete assembly including any articulated parts and sub-objects

cards.tex_maps: 2048x2048 packed PBR per REL-ART-029; micro-noise detail normal on all mineral surfaces; worn-path wear masked into the thresholds and the cleft apron.

mat_rule.construction: Faceted mineral only. The shell is banded strata sampled as straight-sided prisms; a subdivided or smoothed dome breaches REL-ART-029.
mat_rule.emissive: Localised amber, <= 15% of surface area as a CEILING not a target. Amber appears only in the worker hollows, the growth seams between bands, and the spire veins.
mat_rule.forbidden: No machined panel, bolt, conduit or plate seam; no cyan; nothing volcanic — no lava, fire, smoke or molten cracks.

components: A wide grown dome of banded strata, breadth greater than shell height
Several arched worker hollows at the base with walkable thresholds (five in the current build)
A matter-intake cleft whose silhouette is distinct from a worker arch: lower and wider, with a receiving lip and a mineral-lined recess
A crown of rooted adaptation spires emerging from the shell strata, not mounted on it

motion.rig: Static primary structure. Canon's motion is a slow interior glow breath and a cleft settle on delivery, neither of them geometric.
motion.articulated_requirement: PENDING, not waived: a small articulated assembly for the cleft settle on delivery. Do not mark this asset compliant until it is implemented or this card is amended.
motion.root_motion: None. The Hearth never moves and cannot be rebuilt in standard play.

readability: LOD1 shall preserve the crown, the worker hollows, the intake cleft and the headquarters silhouette at gameplay distance. A LOD that drops the spires, closes the hollows, or loses the cleft's distinct silhouette fails this card regardless of triangle count.
The intake cleft must never read as another worker arch: that distinction is the asset's whole navigational job.
Damage must be legible in the tactical camera, not only in a close view.

cards.subject: Waystone
cards.function: REL-BLD-016.KA.WAYSTONE — mobile supply node, 390 HP, 500 cm sight, +5 logistics while rooted, 2x2 footprint; uproot 40 ticks, root 60 ticks, 120 cm/s mobile at 125% damage taken

mesh_prop.scope: the complete assembly including the root ring and the grown carriage
mesh_prop.budget_note: Tighter than the 8,000/3,500 default because this is a 2x2 monolith that must also move; the mobile state pays a cost the static structures do not.

cards.tex_maps: 2048x2048 packed PBR per REL-ART-029; ground-contact wear masked into the root ring.

mat_rule.construction: Faceted dark strata monolith. The carriage is grown mineral, not a machined chassis and not a tread.
mat_rule.emissive: Amber seams up the monolith, <= 15% surface area as a ceiling. Seam brightness is the rooted/uprooted tell only in combination with the roots; it is never the sole tell.
mat_rule.forbidden: No wheels, tracks, treads, pistons or machined carriage. No cyan.

components: A tall faceted monolith of stacked dark strata courses with amber seams
A stepped root plinth at the base
A ring of root-strata that splays flat into the ground when rooted and retracts into braided bundles when mobile
A grown carriage plate on four stubby legs that lifts the monolith when uprooted

motion.rig: Own rig, not shared: root plus a root-ring assembly and a carriage assembly. Provisional plan is 7 bones — root, ring_sink, carriage_lift and FOUR carriage feet. It is NOT the Hearth's static plan and NOT any unit's limb plan. (Corrected 2026-09-07: this card first said three feet, written before the candidate was traced. The candidate's MIGRATING view shows four legs under the carriage plate, and the concept governs the form, so the card was corrected rather than the model bent to fit it.)
clips: root (60 ticks: preparation, contact, settling, release)
motion.root_motion: None. The runtime owns translation while mobile.

states.rooted: the root ring is sunk into the ground and the amber seams hold a steady low glow
states.uprooted_mobile: the ring is clear of the ground, the carriage carries the monolith, and the seams read unsettled
states.destroyed: the monolith falls and the ring is left in the ground

readability: Rooted or moving shall be readable from the roots alone at gameplay distance, per canon. A LOD that removes the root ring fails this card.
The vulnerable uproot and root windows are the opponent's counterplay, so both transitions must be visibly distinct from the settled states.

cards.subject: Growth Basin
cards.function: REL-BLD-016.KA.BASIN — production centre, 700 HP, 500 cm sight, 4x4 footprint; enables warform adaptation within 600 cm; 80-tick molt at 150% damage taken

mesh_prop.scope: the complete assembly including every molt niche

cards.tex_maps: 2048x2048 packed PBR per REL-ART-029; the pool surface carries its own emissive mask channel so brightness can be driven without a second material.

mat_rule.construction: A shallow bowl of grown strata. Faceted throughout.
mat_rule.emissive: Amber concentrated in the matrix pool at the centre, with a lesser read in the molt niches. <= 15% surface area as a ceiling; the pool is allowed to dominate that budget because canon makes it the asset's identity.
mat_rule.forbidden: No machinery around the rim, no vats, no pipework. No cyan.

components: A shallow bowl of grown strata, circular in plan
An amber-lit matrix pool at the centre, 0.75 of the bowl diameter as traced

SIX open curved molt alcoves cut into a continuous outer ring, each large enough to hold a warform and each individually readable. Six is this asset's VISUAL COMPONENT COUNT, confirmed by the owner on 2026-09-07 following the concept. It is NOT a concurrent-molt capacity and implies no gameplay slots.
A per-niche amber floor and back-wall lip that light only while that alcove is in use — the occupancy tell

motion.rig: Own rig, not shared: a static bowl with per-alcove articulation. Root plus one bone per alcove, each carrying canon's crack-and-settle at molt completion. It is NOT the Hearth's plan and NOT the Waystone's carriage plan. The alcoves are OPEN — no hood or lid is required (owner ruling 2026-09-07: the open-alcove, crack-and-settle treatment is the selected direction).

states.idle: the pool holds a low steady glow and every niche floor is dark
states.growing: the pool brightens; this is the pool's emissive, a material parameter, not geometry
states.molting: the alcoves in use have their floor and back-wall lip lit; the rest stay dark. Which alcoves are lit follows authoritative adaptation activity.
states.damaged: the bowl cracked and the pool dimmed
states.destroyed: the bowl broken and the pool dark

readability: The pool must say 'grows warforms' and the alcoves must say 'adaptation choices' at gameplay distance; LOD1 shall preserve both.
SIX open alcoves, following the concept. This is a visual component count only.

Occupancy lighting shall reflect AUTHORITATIVE ADAPTATION ACTIVITY. It must not imply six independently available gameplay slots, and no six-unit limit, reservation, queue or other adaptation rule follows from this card. The number of lit alcoves is a presentation of what the runtime reports, never a promise about capacity.
Maximum-zoom readability of the occupancy tell is OPEN until verified. The lit floor and back-wall lip are legible in the tactical camera but subtle at full zoom-out; this is not yet closed.

cards.subject: Listening Spine
cards.function: REL-BLD-016.KA.SPINE — seismic detection, 440 HP, 900 cm sight, 2x2 footprint; detects moving signatures within 2,600 cm at 200 cm resolution, lingering 40 ticks

mesh_prop.scope: the complete assembly including the rooted socket
mesh_prop.budget_note: Well under the default because canon specifies a single rib in a socket; spending 8,000 triangles on one rib would produce detail no LOD could keep.

mat_rule.construction: A single tall faceted rib of strata set into a rooted socket. Faceted, tapering, asymmetric.
mat_rule.emissive: Amber sensor nodules climbing the rib, <= 15% surface area as a ceiling. The nodules are individually addressable so they can light in sequence.
mat_rule.forbidden: No dish, antenna, radar or mast language — canon says 'a spine, not a weapon'. No cyan.

components: One tall rib of strata
Amber sensor nodules climbing it, individually addressable
A rooted socket at the base

motion.rig: Own rig, not shared: root, socket, and a two-bone rib that can lean toward a detected direction. Provisional plan is 4 bones. It is NOT a turret rig — the rib leans, it does not aim.
clips: idle_pulse (a slow pulse that quickens with signatures)
detect_sweep (nodules light in sequence toward the source direction)

states.contact: the nodules light in sequence toward the source direction
states.damaged: part of the nodule run dark and the rib chipped
states.destroyed: the rib snapped at the socket

readability: The sequence direction is the asset's only information channel and shall survive LOD1: the nodules must remain individually resolvable at gameplay distance.
It must never read as a weapon or a comms mast.

cards.subject: Tender
cards.function: Worker: 100 HP, 390 cm/s, 920 cm sight, work rate 9, cargo 10

mesh_prop.budget_note: The owner selected these bounds specifically for the Tender on 2026-09-07 and directed on 2026-09-07 that they be retained. They are NOT replaced by the 8,000/3,500 default.

mat_rule.construction: Faceted Kharuun mineral anatomy. Two material slots maximum.
mat_rule.emissive: Amber <= 5% of surface area, concentrated at the working wrist nodules — tighter than the faction's 15% ceiling, by the owner's Tender selection.
mat_rule.forbidden: Surveyor machinery, tread language and the cyan treatment do not transfer.

components: Stocky cultivator body with forearms thickened by working strata
A resonance staff
A woven mineral-fibre sling of carried matter across the back
Amber nodules at the wrists

motion.rig: The existing 19-bone humanoid cultivator rig, retained by owner selection, subject to deformation and animation checks.
clips: gather (a kneeling press of the staff into strata)
grow (a slow circling walk leaving the first ring)

readability: Carried matter and the staff must say cultivator, not soldier, at gameplay distance.

cards.subject: Riftstalker
cards.function: Mobile skirmisher: 125 HP, 410 cm/s, 1,050 cm sight, 14 damage at 500 cm on a 22-tick cooldown; molts at a Growth Basin

mesh_prop.scope: the complete assembly including the shard-caster and every molt variant part carried on the same asset
mesh_prop.budget_note: Below the default because this is a light frame that must read as light; mass spent on triangles tends to become mass on screen.

mat_rule.construction: Lean long-limbed warform, faceted charcoal carapace. Low forward posture built into the rest pose, not only into the animation.
mat_rule.emissive: Amber seams along the carapace, <= 15% surface area as a ceiling.
mat_rule.forbidden: No Meridian plating or conduits. It must visibly lack the mass for a frontal fight.

components: A lean long-limbed body in a low forward posture
A faceted charcoal carapace with amber seams
A shoulder-mounted shard-caster that fires while moving
Molt-variant carapace and striker parts, separately controllable

motion.rig: Own rig, not shared: a long-limbed skirmisher plan with three-segment limbs, a long neck, and a two-bone caster mount that aims independently of the gait. Provisional plan is 24 bones. It is explicitly NOT the Tender's humanoid rig and NOT the Cairnback's heavy plan.
clips: sidestep (a short sidestep after each shot)

readability: The forward lean and light frame must say 'skirmisher that keeps moving' at gameplay distance.
A molt must be visible on the unit itself, not only in the interface.
Firing while moving must be legible: the caster's line and the gait must not fight each other.

cards.subject: Cairnback
cards.function: Assault screen: 245 HP, 270 cm/s, 800 cm sight, 16 damage at 200 cm; casts mineral cover at 450 cm — a 180 HP barrier of 75 cm half-extent lasting 300 ticks

mesh_prop.scope: the complete assembly. The grown mineral cover it creates is a SEPARATE asset with its own budget and is not counted here.

cards.tex_maps: 2048x2048 packed PBR per REL-ART-029; the strata back carries a heat-hold gradient in its own mask.

mat_rule.construction: Broad low body; the back is a slab of layered heat-holding strata. Thick forelimbs, head low and protected.
mat_rule.emissive: Amber restricted to the seams between back strata, <= 15% surface area as a ceiling. The back is armour, not a lamp.
mat_rule.forbidden: No Meridian shield-panel language; the Bulwark's barrier system does not transfer.

components: A broad low body with the head carried low and protected
A layered strata back slab
Thick forelimbs capable of the heave

motion.rig: Own rig, not shared: a heavy low-slung plan with four thick limb chains, a short protected neck, and a back-slab chain that flexes on the heave. Provisional plan is 22 bones, weighted toward the limbs and the back rather than the extremities.
clips: heave (leaves a grown barrier behind it)

readability: The strata back must say 'absorbs fire, becomes cover' at gameplay distance and shall survive LOD1.
The heave must read as the source of the barrier that appears, so the cast origin and the barrier's placement must agree.
Damage chips the strata visibly; that is the unit's health tell.

cards.subject: Resonant
cards.function: Scout and counter-scout: 85 HP, 470 cm/s, 1,550 cm sight, 8 damage at 380 cm; vibration detection to 2,200 cm at 200 cm resolution, lingering 40 ticks

mesh_prop.scope: the complete assembly including every sensor fin
mesh_prop.budget_note: Matched to the Tender's selected bounds because both are light non-combat frames; the fins are the only place the budget should go.

cards.tex_maps: 2048x2048 packed PBR per REL-ART-029; the fins carry a translucency mask.

mat_rule.construction: Tall, thin, delicate frame. Faceted but slender — the delicacy is the read.
mat_rule.emissive: Translucent amber sensor fins along the spine and head, individually addressable so they can brighten in sequence. <= 15% surface area as a ceiling.
mat_rule.forbidden: No weapon read. Its 8 damage is incidental; the silhouette must not promise a fight.

components: A tall thin delicate body
Sensor fins of translucent amber along the spine
Head fins, individually addressable

motion.rig: Own rig, not shared: a slender biped plan with a segmented spine carrying an addressable fin array. Provisional plan is 26 bones, most of them in the spine and the fins rather than the limbs — the inverse of the Cairnback's weighting.

readability: Fins and delicacy must say 'listens, does not fight' at gameplay distance.
The detection sequence is the unit's information channel and shall survive LOD1: fins must stay individually resolvable.
It must be distinguishable from the Riftstalker at a glance — the two share a faction and a light frame but not a role.
